content:
A new prop appears to have gained steam at the Republican National Convention — ear bandages.
MAGA world is no stranger to Donald Trump-themed merchandise, whether it's Trump-themed shoes or a new
campaign T-shirt
featuring his new running mate's name.
Photos emerged Tuesday of
Trump
supporters wearing bandages over their ears in what appears to be in solidarity with
Trump's own bandage
he wore during his
RNC
appearance Monday night. Trump wore the bandage after an assassination attempt left the MAGA leader bloodied at a Saturday rally.
And the internet couldn't stop laughing, relentlessly mocking MAGA supporters on X.
Read also:
Former supporters featured on anti-Trump billboards at Republican National Convention
"The official one will be
numbered and cost $47
," wrote @patriottakes.
"Nooooooo," wrote @HadleySheley, adding three cry-laughing emojis. "so now they’re all
wearing maxi pads on their ear
"
She added that she "can't" and finished: "These people are so weird."
"Yeah,
don't get me started on the diaper thing
..." quipped @RareClarity101.
"lmao! he’ll be wearing this next," wrote @BabeGrl, attaching a photoshopped image of
ultra-thin women's pads over Trump's right ear
."
"They are
selling those in the lobby
for five dollars each," quipped @DenisonBarbs. "They have Donald Trump’s initials on one side of them."
The convention has faced questions over its vendors this week. A vendor was
giving away a Daniel Defense-branded
AR-15 rifle days after the assassination attempt. The military-style weapon is the same type of rifle used in the Butler, Pennsylvania shooting.
